description: Vinegar circuit extracted from the calibrated MaleCNS v1.0 connectome
credit: MaleCNS v1.0 (Berg et al., Cell 2026; HHMI Janelia, Cambridge, MRC LMB, Google Research), CC-BY 4.0. LIF model parameters from Shiu et al., Nature 2024.

changes: dopamine, octopamine, serotonin outputs removed (slow modulators)
Kenyon cell to Kenyon cell connections removed
brain input onto sensory neurons removed
excitatory ALLN to ALLN connections removed
each neuron's total excitatory input capped at the 95th percentile
excitatory ALLN to ALPN connections removed (eLN to PN excitation is mainly electrical)
excitatory ALPN to ALPN connections removed (mostly dendro-dendritic)
